transcript: The secret to losing weight fast isn't chasing diets. It's discipline and removing what blocks your body. Your body already knows how to change. You just need to stop interfering with it. Start by walking for 10 minutes after every meal to wake digestion and teach your body to burn instead of store. Eat within an 8-hour window and let your system rest and repair the rest of the day. This isn't a trend. It's how humans lived for centuries. For 7 days, remove sugar, fried oils and late night snacking and watch your face slim, your belly settle and your energy rise. Drink clean water instead of liquid calories and keep your food simple and real. Rice, vegetables, eggs, fruit, soups, lean protein. When you stop confusing your body, it responds fast. Follow this for 7 days and you'll see the first change. In 14 days, you'll feel lighter, clearer and back in control of your body. If this helped you, follow this page and share this video with someone who needs it. And if you want deeper guidance, my ebook is linked in my profile.
